notes.title: 2025 Roadmap #1
notes.notes: [p]🚨 Officers,[/p][p][/p][p]Our work on SWAT Commander continues! If you want to support it, remember that you can always take a look at [b]our special soundtrack bundle[/b] and currently get the game for a steal![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58925/SWAT_Commander__Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In other news, we're sending you some fresh intel in the form of [b]a roadmap for our nearest milestones.[/b] Check out our plans for new missions and mission customization:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/17586f3b8aef65b118e14e48b0b8acec8e7c9e49.png"][/img][i]SWAT Commander 2025 Roadmap #1[/i][/p][p][/p][p]And now for something completely different. I've always wanted to say this unironically — it's a feature, not a bug.[/p][p]Many of you have been wondering [b]if suspects shooting at you through doors is a correct game mechanic in SWAT Commander[/b], so we wanted to provide a mini-tutorial to explain it a little better.[/p][p]Basically, violent [b]suspects in SWAT Commander can take a shot at you through a closed door even if they don't see you[/b]. Since they can hear you, this sort of incident can happen if you don't follow protocol and [b]move noisily around right behind the door[/b]. To prevent this, [b]equip your Tactical Mirror[/b], which puts you into a more stealthy mode and [b]try to stay by the sides of door frames[/b] whenever you can.[/p][p]The [b]upcoming Game Customization update[/b] that you can see in the roadmap above is going to include [b]an option to turn off the door shot mechanic completely. [/b]Based on your feedback, [b]we can also consider tweaking this mechanic further to improve your experience[/b].[/p][p]What's more, playing SWAT Commander on the [b]'Easy' difficulty level[/b] already [b]disables this mechanic[/b] in the current game version![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OY6L6wD71o4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Also, as always, thanks your feedback and keep it coming! Are there any features 'you' would like to see addressed in our updates? Stand by for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: SWAT Commander v.0.7.7.5 – Game Mode Update!
notes.notes: [p]🚨 Officers,[/p][p][/p][p]We're deploying an update for SWAT Commander to [b]version 0.7.7.5![/b][/p][p]This time, we introduce our first additions of [i]Advanced[/i] game modes to the missions — "Random Range" and "Tank on Tank"![/p][p][/p][p]Remember that for the next week, [b]SWAT Commander is available at a 20% discount![/b] This is a great moment to grab our game if you haven't yet because we're not done with our updates. [b]New mission coming September 29th, so don't miss out![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619310/SWAT_Commander/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]What are game modes?[/b] Well, let's do a [b]quick recap[/b] — game modes are basically different configurations that you can apply to your mission's playthrough while setting it up. The ones we've had so far for every mission (which [b]we'll refer to from now on as the [i]Classic[/i] game modes[/b]) came in three options. Game modes alter many properties of a mission, including its objectives, environment details, the behavior and equipment used by the suspects you encounter, and even some core mechanics. So let's talk about the [b]new ones![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/c25ad4a2d7bcdaee23df471cd43eaed3660ce14f.png"][/img][i]You can find the Advanced Game Modes tab here after selecting the mission you want to play[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Random Range[/b] — Your intel was bad, Commander. As in, "the investigation team is to report to the chief of police immediately" level of bad. [b]Nothing matches, nothing makes sense, and worse yet — you have scracely little hope of knowing what's in store![/b] Terrorist bombers on a farm? No one saw that coming. Why are there gangers teaming up with hillbillies and where is your backup? All good questions, such a shame there's no time for answers. It's just you and your adaptation skills stretched to their limits.[/p][p][b]Tank on Tank[/b] — Well, well, look who's bringing out the big guns! Unfortunately, it's the suspects. Yep, [b]they're packing some serious heat with advanced weapons, heavy armor, and top-of-the-line shields.[/b] Ouch. You know how they say fight fire with fire, so you'd better follow suit if you're to stand any chance of bringing in these tanky perps. Only the biggest bullet sponges will survive this intense encounter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/a4fd18172f1faf45fe2363873fe24ca6bfb5d85c.png"][/img][i]Remember that you can find the Headcam view that lets you observe the game from the SWAT officer's helmet-mounted camera in the gameplay settings[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]SWAT Commander v.0.7.7.5 - Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]GAME FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Advanced Game Mode for each mission — Random Range[/p][/*][*][p]New Advanced Game Mode for each mission — Tank on Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EQUIPMENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added randomization of attachments when using the randomize current equipment button on the equipment screen [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the player names setting in the pause menu not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with input settings not initializing correctly on clients[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the [b]Tank on Tank game mode in action[/b] while using the [b]headcam view feature[/b] during the Breaking Point mission:[/p][previewyoutube="ajKK5dnQzV8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]After the [b]next, new mission update[/b], it'll be time for [b]a roadmap[/b] with more of our update plans laid out for you to investigate![/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

This mode is [b]can be enabled in both single player and co-op[/b].[/p][p]Consider using the headcam mode to relive our experience from a brand new perspective or for an opportunity to create improved gameplay footage to share with your friends and viewers![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/a4fd18172f1faf45fe2363873fe24ca6bfb5d85c.png"][/img][i]Remember that you can find the Headcam view that lets you observe the game from the SWAT officer's helmet-mounted camera in the gameplay settings[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]SWAT Commander v.0.7.7.4 - Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]GAME FEATURE[/b][/p][list][*][p]Headcam mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]AI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the Suspect's morale system to make their surrendering more realistic[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the headcam mode in action:[/p][previewyoutube="Hl9IDLDIwQ0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Remember that our game's [b]soundtrack[/b] is also now available, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58925/SWAT_Commander__Soundtrack/"]together with the Early Access version in a bundle![/url] If you didn't decide to get the game yet, it's a great opportunity to do it now! Stay tuned for our next updates, including [b]game mode customization![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Over and out,[/p][p]SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: Prologue Patch/Development Updates – 06
notes.notes:
[p]Officers, 👮‍♂️[/p][p]We’re rolling out [b]a big update for SWAT Commander: Prologue[/b]! Check out our patch notes for details on all the improvements: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2428730/announcements/detail/545611272206420614"][/dynamiclink]We've got more features and changes coming to our Early Access version and once again, we'd like to discuss a select few along with a short video presentation. Many of these focus particularly with the convenience of gameplay in mind.[/p][previewyoutube="cJUb2Hi0p5U;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p][b]The Evidence Hint system[/b]: A new feature introduced in an effort to make the Evidence collection aspect of the game more manageable. This should prove helpful, for example, in case you get stuck on finding a particularly difficult to spot piece of evidence or elusive suspect.[/p][p]A voiced report from TOC informs you about the location of this objective and a prompt on screen directs you towards it. [b]We're currently considering scaling this feature across difficulty levels.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Filter for door-related commands:[/b] From now, the commands you can issue to your SWAT officers that are related to doors and doorways are dependent on both on the state of that given door together with the equipment available to your squad. [/p][p]In order to know how you can proceed with the door, you need to investigate it with your Officers stacking up on it and if it turns out to be locked, you can proceed with lockpicking or breaching commands.[/p][p]This serves to both add more realism to the game and clean up the Command List considerably.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The "Search and Secure" Command[/b]: A new command joins the SWAT arsenal! With Search and Secure, you can have your team or your entire squad perform a search of a cleared room for Suspects, Civilians, or Evidence to secure. [/p][p]The AI system selects appropriate targets in an organized way and completes these objectives for you. Just make sure to be on alert as severe vulnerability is the cost of this procedure![/p][/*][/list][p]We have more to report, so stick with us for further [b]summaries of other fixes and improvements[/b] making their way to the upcoming EA release. [/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to check out our [b]free co-op prologue[/b] if you haven't tried the game yet!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/SWAT_Commander_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink]Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team[/p]

notes.title: Development Updates – 05
notes.notes:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

Our today's report discusses [b]the latest improvements added to the upcoming Early Access version of the game[/b] since the prologue's release. There's plenty to choose from, and we'll cover more in our next devlogs, but for now have our first picks: 

[list][*][b]Character responses to gunshots[/b]: For improved realism, the game's characters will now have a broader range of responses to weapons being discharged or similar response-inducing situations, such as restrained suspects flinching if there's someone firing a gun nearby.
[*][b]Improved AI following[/b]: Targeting, positioning, providing cover. There are lots of factors a SWAT squad has to take into account when following their leader if they're to be safe and effective. We're working to optimize the various behaviors connected with these actions to make them as helpful to you as possible in single player.
[*][b]Equipment presets[/b]: Figured out a few gear setups you'd like to use when fulfilling different roles in the squad? Want to save them and freely change them when playing the missions either in single player or co-op? You'll be able to do just that with the preset feature. Our future updates will include default presets that can perform well in various situations.

notes.title: Development Updates – 02
notes.notes:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

Here's something we added for the sake of both our new and returning players and the experience it's meant to improve for you through visual enhancements.
There are a few such changes we're introducing, so we'll write more about them in future posts as they become ready.

[h3]Weather and time-of-day variants[/h3]

The various missions of SWAT Commander will be available in randomly selected variants for weather and time-of-day combinations. However, our system will track your previous configuration, so it doesn't repeat throughout mission playthroughs.

This opens possibilities of replaying your favorite mission under an entirely different mood or setting. Silence of the Hansons in broad daylight? Hot Reception with a roaring thunderstorm outside? All a possibility. ⛈️

What’s more, these conditions affect the behavior of characters, adding another tactical layer to the game. For example, manipulating the fuse box at night can give you an advantage by making it harder for Suspects to aim but instantly making them alert. Mind the mission briefing, however. Some Suspects may come equipped for such circumstances! 🔦

notes.title: SWAT Commander!
notes.notes:
[i]– Status report?
– The name of the game has changed.
– We're gonna need details.[/i]

Officers,

And details you shall receive. You're bound to have noticed that you're looking at a completely different game title in your announcements. Yes, "Tactical Squad: SWAT Stories" is now officially "SWAT Commander".

[b]Why and what does that involve?[/b]

The main reason why we're doing this is because we want to refresh our game's image and start operating under a more concise, recognizable name. All in an effort to have our game reach more players more easily. A sort of a fresh start if you will.
But are we expecting a new name to do the trick? Certainly not, after all the work and improvements that have been put into the game, we're bringing back more regular updates to let you know what we're planning – here on Steam, our Discord server, our X feed, perhaps even more?
In fact, we may soon just have some news for you around the corner that involve great opportunities for SWAT Commander!

[b]Is this a different game now? Are there new developers? Were you facing any problems?[/b]

None of the above, luckily! We're still working together as the exact same team on the exact same tactical team shooter simulating special police forces operations with both single player modes and co-op. Our previous name caused no problems for the game or the project's continuity. We all just strongly believe that this new title will be much more manageable and effective and telling the world what kind of game we want to bring it.

So, stay tuned for more updates. After all, it won't be much longer until you can play our game and, as mentioned above, we're going to have a lot to report on.

Over and out,

notes.title: Development Briefing – 5 | New Devlog Episode!
notes.notes:
Officers,

Sometimes the only way out of a situation is to get up close and personal.

[b]5 – Shotguns[/b]

Experience tells us the purpose of the shotgun – from the earliest Doom games to modern shooters, it's the killing device that offers high damage, typically at the cost of short range and high spread (but that can also be an advantage). The hostiles you'll be facing in Tactical Squad are well aware of these weapons' qualities, so if you see someone taking a close position against your team, it's time to act fast – don't let them get too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/afa603f13cf20afb39b7d170f21ed0c554a1f8c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/28437b04e44e4ce37b67e4aa411c8a7c84b5a07c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/c4f08eeb30213ec58424bd776278e70da10c623e.png[/img]

Luckily, the same option for planning out your own moves is very much available to you. Aside from the breaching shotgun, a non-lethal, definitive means to opening doors that resist more subtle solutions, there is also your standard-issue shotgun. There's more versatility to it than you might expect from our intro, though – you can use the pre-mission Equipment screen to outfit your operative in the type of ammo that suits your tactical needs:
● buckshot – whose spread covers a wide area but travels at low range,
● slug – one bullet, but allows you to shoot at a higher distance,
● bean bag – used for less lethal apprehension of suspects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/99282899b2e8c885380e737a7827edaf04c6f7fc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/e744e97bae57120e5a1aaf2b54f32e5f09ba6dd4.png[/img]

And last but certainly not least – if you want more updates, here's a reminder that we've uploaded a brand new devlog video for our game. Check it out right here:

[previewyoutube=dPsUNCerKcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development Briefing – 4
notes.notes:
Officers,

One man's meat is another's poison.

[b]4 – The House[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/af445da69293261e72dcf32a91087707ad603d35.png[/img]

Most people have a place in their life where they feel relaxed and secure, and most people call that place home. But if you were to have this power to look into every home, what kind of people would you bet on finding inside? Would you feel as safe and confident around them as they do, inside their home?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/15d8ddf0242739485c324a7a3e6fee8fadd3d11c.png[/img]

Here's a sneak preview of another level you'll be facing in Tactical Squad – "The House." A regular, detached, single-family residential building. While, as always, we're hesitant to reveal too much information about the map's layout for the good of your experience, there are surely a few obvious or predictable things about a place like this. The rooms, the decor, the furnishings. What's always unpredictable about a house circles back to our original point – the people inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40516656/b93d2eadd3776c382979d99cf932bfd24756dc74.png[/img]

Have a close look at our screenshots and try putting your imagination to work on them a bit. We're talking about a special forces unit initiating an intervention in there. What could have prompted that? What's been happening inside the House? And, most importantly, what can you do to resolve whatever situation is taking place there?

notes.title: Development Briefing – 3
notes.notes:
Officers,

Getting to know your enemies is a crucial step in defeating them.

[b]3 – Enemy Equipment[/b]

In Tactical Squad, you'll be facing people who come into conflict with the law for a variety of reasons. You'll be briefed on the currently developing situation before you engage, and it'll be up to you to determine the best way to prepare for it. For example the equipment employed is of key importance here. Are they run-of-the-mill street thugs? Or maybe an organized gang or even terrorists? Does this mean they're just going to wield some standard black-market guns or are they going to be equipped with high-quality gear that's got armor-piercing capabilities on top of some additional utilities? 

Whatever happens, it'll never just be a straightforward reflection of your own arsenal.

notes.title: Development Briefing – 2
notes.notes:
Officers,

Tactics are grounded in your earlier choice of actions. Nothing is ever truly tactical without the freedom to make that choice.

[b]2 – Weapon Variety[/b]

It'll come as little surprise that in Tactical Squad the weapons with which you choose to equip your operatives are a foundation of your tactics. Already diverse in their types, they further branch out into different properties such as weight, firing modes, ammo capacities, and ammo types. Following faithfully the arsenal at the disposal of genuine police units, the game features weapons inspired by such icons as the Beretta, Sig, Colt, as well as Heckler & Koch rifles, submachine guns, and even launchers.

notes.title: Development Briefing – 1
notes.notes:
Officers,

Welcome to the Briefing, a new series of short posts that we will be running here in the Steam Community space. 
In it, you will be informed, or briefed, on selected steps that the team are taking in the process of creating Tactical Squad.
It will be independent from our Devlogs, which are videos presenting major news and milestones in the game's development. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8apb1X2X_RU]Check out the starter episode here[/url].
And with that, on to the first Briefing.

[b]1 – Weather System[/b]

Any game that tries to introduce a little tension into its gameplay can accomplish it in a variety of ways, and one of them is the atmosphere of its setting. There's nothing like a violent thunderstorm to create that truly tense atmosphere.

Tactical Squad is going to feature a special weather system that introduces randomised atmospheric conditions in the game's missions. Of course some missions will take place during the day, while others at night, so the conditions will be appropriate to the setting. You will also be able to control this system in the game's settings. Check out the results in the gallery down below.
